photos.description: Far more than just a picturesque valley along the Sázava River, lower Posázaví is the historic cradle of Czech tramping culture, where wild nature has blended with the romance of the American Old West since the 1920s. Nestled among rocky cliffs and river bends along the "Golden River," wooden log cabins, hand-carved totem poles, and flagpoles stand to this day—preserving a unique atmosphere of freedom, nostalgia, and outdoor heritage. Autumn, 2023
